Review Firecrawl?

Reviewers describe Firecrawl as a reliable way to turn messy web pages into clean, structured, LLM-ready data, especially for AI agents and research workflows. They repeatedly praise easy setup, clear docs, and an API that avoids building and maintaining custom scrapers. One user says it makes extracting meaningful data from unstructured content far more dependable and saves manual work. Makers of Agentplace.io, Crewdle, and Jet Admin echo that, citing clean output, scale, and solid crawling on complex sites.

LLM Developer Tools [...] Huge shoutout to Firecrawl for powering the web data layer behind Crewdle. When you're building AI agents and chat that need clean, reliable access to the web, scraping is usually the messiest part of the stack. We looked at building our own crawler and a few other scraping APIs, but Firecrawl won for three reasons: 🔹 LLM-ready output — It returns clean markdown, not a tangle of raw HTML we'd have to parse ourselves. That saved us weeks. 🔹 Reliability at scale — It handles JavaScript-heavy sites, rate limits, and edge cases that would've eaten our engineering time. 🔹 Simple, developer-first API — We were up and running in an afternoon instead of fighting infrastructure. If you're building anything that needs to turn the web into structured data for AI, Firecrawl is the tool we'd [...] web into structured data for AI, Firecrawl is the tool we'd recommend.
